thread:
FinanceOps: Heads up : Nightly reconciliation flagged 212 mismatched invoices between Stripe export and NetSuite import. Many are small FX rounding differences but ~24 show >$100 variance. Report: /reports/billing/mismatch_2024-09-08.csv
Ivy: Investigated samples. Root cause looks like CSV export from Stripe included a UTF-8 BOM and some amounts had non-breaking-space thousand separators. Our importer used Windows-1252 and didn't strip NBSP, so amounts parsed wrong (e.g., "1,200.00" -> 120000). Also rounding to 3 decimals in intermediate step caused FX drift for multi-currency invoices.
Sam: Nice catch. I found logs where importer wrote amount_cents = cast(replace(amount_str, ',', '') as numeric) * 100 but replace didn't remove NBSP. Patch suggestion: normalize unicode, strip BOM, enforce UTF-8, and parse with locale-aware decimal.
Operations: Also add checksum on CSV (sha256) and compare file size + checksum from Stripe webhook metadata before processing to avoid partial uploads. We had one partial file processed due to pipeline retry.
Ivy: Quick fix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/639  -- changes: importer force-utf8, unicode.normalize('NFKC'), strip \uFEFF, remove all whitespace characters from numeric fields before parse, and round only at presentation layer. Also added a migration to reprocess last 7 days of affected invoices.
AccountingBot: ALERT: mismatch_count > 200. Auto-ticket FIN-3321 created.
Sam: SQL I ran to find large deltas: 
```
select s.id as stripe_id, ns.id as ns_id, s.amount_cents, ns.amount_cents, abs(s.amount_cents - ns.amount_cents) as delta
from stripe_invoices s
join ns_invoices ns on s.customer_id = ns.customer_id and date(s.created_at) = date(ns.created_at)
where abs(s.amount_cents - ns.amount_cents) > 10000;
```
Found 24 rows.
FinanceOps: Plan: (1) deploy importer fix to staging + run reprocess dry-run (Ivy), (2) once validated, schedule reprocess in maintenance window 20:30-21:00 PT and publish CSV of corrected invoices (Accounting + Ops), (3) alert rule for future >0.2% mismatch rate.
deploy-bot: deploy started for canary/importer 2024-09-08T17:05Z :rocket:
Sam: After deploy, I'll run the reprocess dry-run and upload a corrections CSV to FIN-3321. If any correction >$1k, require manual approval before NetSuite patch.
FinanceOps: Approved. Please keep thread updates.
